name: Data Architect
responsibilities: Design the schemas and data models other teams' applications and reports are built on for years
Set standards for how data is stored, queried, and secured across the warehouse or platform
Plan how new systems and data sources integrate into the existing architecture without breaking it
skills: Modeling data (relational, dimensional, or warehouse schemas) that stays coherent as scale and requirements grow
Reasoning about scalability, security, and performance trade-offs in a database design before it ships
Documenting and communicating schemas with accepted notations so other engineers can build on them safely
Evaluating and integrating database management, ETL, and cloud storage tools into a working system
rawSkillPool: Data modeling for warehouses and applications
Data base user interface and query software
Object or component oriented development software

evidence.title: Database Architects (SOC 15-1243.00), O*NET 29.1 database
evidence.quote: Design strategies for enterprise databases, data warehouse systems, and multidimensional networks. Set standards for database operations, programming, query processes, and security. Model, design, and construct large relational databases or data warehouses.

evidence.title: Database Architects: Tasks, O*NET 29.1 database
evidence.quote: Develop and document database architectures. Design databases to support business applications, ensuring system scalability, security, performance, and reliability. Develop data models for applications, metadata tables, views or related database structures.
